turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Who decided Owen gets a zero?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
Don't tell me what my mind is. Who decided?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
I'm going there next. You've said nothing about Owen's essay yet.
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No. Nothing about this has been between us; Owen found out on his phone, in class. What do you have?
